channel.title: DAWN.COM
channel.description: Pakistan's most widely circulated English language newspaper

item.title: PM Shehbaz chairs NSC meeting after surge in Balochistan attacks - DAWN.COM
item.description: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif convened the National Security Committee on Friday to review the deteriorating security situation in Balochistan after a spate of militant attacks.

item.title: ECP announces by-election schedule for Punjab, KP constituencies
item.description: The Election Commission of Pakistan on Thursday unveiled the schedule for by-elections in six National Assembly seats across Punjab and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

item.title: Pakistan, IMF reach staff-level agreement after week-long talks - DAWN.COM
item.description: Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb said Pakistan and the IMF reached a staff-level agreement on the next tranche following extensive negotiations in Islamabad.

item.title: PM announces relief package for flood-hit areas of Sindh
item.description: Shehbaz Sharif announced a fresh relief package for flood-affected districts of Sindh as monsoon rains continue to batter the province.

item.title: NAB files reference against former provincial minister in land case
item.description: The National Accountability Bureau filed a reference against a former Punjab minister over alleged irregularities in a housing scheme land deal.

item.title: Bilawal Bhutto calls for federal support over Sindh flood response - DAWN.COM
item.description: PPP chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari urged the federal government to expedite disaster funding as flood waters continue to displace families in Sindh.

item.title: Senate passes amendment bill on public procurement rules
item.description: The Senate on Wednesday passed a bill amending public procurement rules aimed at increasing transparency in government contracts.

item.title: Ishaq Dar holds talks with visiting Chinese delegation on CPEC projects
item.description: Deputy PM Ishaq Dar met a visiting Chinese delegation to discuss progress on stalled CPEC energy and infrastructure projects.
